info.name: CROIP Central Platform API
info.description:
Central Revenue Oversight & Integration Platform — all 11 microservice APIs, plus the Zitadel-backed staff auth flow and the ratepayer self-service auth flow (register -> login -> OTP -> property creation). Import the companion environment file alongside this collection.

**Auth model**
- Staff/admin endpoints: real Zitadel-issued Bearer token (`{{staff_access_token}}`). Get one by logging into the portal (http://localhost:3050) as `superuser@croip.com` and copying the access token server-side (see README), or via a machine-credentials grant for service accounts.
- Ratepayer self-service endpoints: no auth for register, then phone/email + password + OTP login issues a separate `{{ratepayer_access_token}}` (HS256, signed by ratepayer-service). Running 'Verify OTP' auto-saves this into the environment.
- A handful of endpoints are genuinely public (ratepayer registration, property claims, receipt verification).

item.name: 0. Zitadel Staff Auth
item.description: Staff (officer/admin) accounts authenticate via real Zitadel OIDC through the portal's browser login — there is no API-only staff login endpoint by design. For Postman testing of staff/admin endpoints, log into http://localhost:3050 as superuser@croip.com, then paste the resulting access token (see docs/portal token-store) into the `staff_access_token` environment variable. Machine (service-account) tokens, used for service-to-service calls, CAN be minted directly below.

request.description: Grant type: client_credentials. Use for service accounts (e.g. property-registry-service's own machine user). Body is form-urlencoded, not JSON — see Body tab.

body.raw:
{
  "eventType": "revenue.bill.paid.v1",
  "eventVersion": 1,
  "producer": "external-psp",
  "aggregateType": "Bill",
  "aggregateId": "{{sample_bill_id}}",
  "aggregateVersion": 1,
  "concessionId": "{{sample_concession_id}}",
  "assemblyId": "{{sample_assembly_id}}",
  "correlationId": "{{$guid}}",
  "data": {
    "note": "example payload \u2014 match the real CloudEvent envelope your producer uses"
  }
}

request.description: assemblyId/concessionId come from the staff caller's own Zitadel token context, not the body.
Documents are mandatory for ratepayer self-service. assemblyId defaults to the ratepayer's own registered assembly — pass assemblyId explicitly in the body only to override it.
devOtpCode is only present because no SMS provider is configured in this dev environment — copy it into the next request.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 200) { const j = pm.response.json(); if (j.devOtpCode) pm.environment.set('ratepayer_otp_code', j.devOtpCode); }
